targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(prompt_cost_usd + completion_cost_usd) AS "Total Cost USD" FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Calls" FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'ok'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)/1000::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Latency" FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND latency_ms > 0
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / GREATEST(COUNT(*), 1)::numeric, 1) AS "Error %" FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT SUM(prompt_tokens) AS "Input Tokens" FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cached' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / GREATEST(COUNT(*), 1)::numeric, 1) AS "Cache %" FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '5m') AS time, model, SUM(prompt_cost_usd + completion_cost_usd) AS cost FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model NOT LIKE 'gemini-test%' GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '5m') AS time, call_site, AVG(latency_ms)/1000 AS latency_s FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND latency_ms > 0 GROUP BY time, call_site ORDER BY time
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model NOT LIKE 'gemini-test%' GROUP BY model ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT call_site, ROUND(SUM(prompt_cost_usd + completion_cost_usd)::numeric, 4) AS cost_usd FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model NOT LIKE 'gemini-test%' GROUP BY call_site ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT model, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS output_tokens FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model NOT LIKE 'gemini-test%' GROUP BY model ORDER BY input_tokens DESC

SELECT model, COUNT(*) as calls, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::numeric / 1000, 1) AS p50_s, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::numeric / 1000, 1) AS p95_s, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::numeric / 1000, 1) AS p99_s, ROUND(SUM(prompt_cost_usd + completion_cost_usd)::numeric, 4) AS total_cost FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND latency_ms > 0 AND model NOT LIKE 'gemini-test%' GROUP BY model ORDER BY calls DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, model, call_site, LEFT(error, 120) AS error FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'error' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '1m') AS time, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT COALESCE(run_id, rfq_id, 'unknown') AS run, ROUND(SUM(prompt_cost_usd + completion_cost_usd)::numeric, 4) AS cost_usd, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM quoteclaw.llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model NOT LIKE 'gemini-test%' GROUP BY run ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 15
